description: JPMorgan’s Kinexys and DBS have launched a service allowing institutional clients to transfer tokenised US dollar deposits between Singapore and the US around the clock. The integration connects their blockchain-based deposit platforms, with Partior coordinating settlement. Ant International is the first client. The service is designed for corporate treasury operations and is not available for consumer payments.
title: JPMorgan and DBS Bring 24/7 Tokenised Dollar Payments to US-Singapore Corridor

description: The Oppo Watch 5 comes with a 351mAh battery that is claimed to deliver up to 10 days of use in its long battery life mode. It also offers NFC payments, Bluetooth 5.2 connectivity and support for Android and iOS devices. The smartwatch features a lightweight aluminium alloy body, built-in satellite positioning and multiple health monitoring tools. Its display reaches up to 3,000 nits of peak brightness in sports mode, while its water and dust resistance ratings include 5ATM, IP69 and IP69K.
title: Oppo Watch 5 Launched With 3,000 Nits Brightness, Up to 10 Days of Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Images of camera lens protectors offer clues about the rear design of Samsung’s upcoming flagship phones. The standard Galaxy S27 and S27+ are tipped to retain three vertically arranged cameras, while the Pro and Ultra models may use a different layout with separate openings for the main and ultrawide sensors. Earlier renders and dummy units have also pointed to a rectangular camera island on the higher-end phones. Firmware findings have hinted at five colour options, though Samsung has not confirmed them.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Series Leaked Lens Protectors Suggest Redesigned Camera Islands

description: Microsoft has revealed the technical reasons behind the major global outage that disrupted Outlook and several other Microsoft 365 services on November 12. According to a company official, the disruption was triggered by a combination of a previously undetected software defect, an increase in network traffic, and reduced server capacity. These factors eventually caused a cascading failure across Microsoft’s infrastructure, with the tech giant initially struggling to restore normal operations.
title: Microsoft Finally Explains Why Major Outlook, Microsoft 365 Outage Happened

description: Apple's new research initiative will explore the role of conversational AI in everyday healthcare, including how people evaluate medical information and prepare for doctor appointments. Developed with OpenEvidence, the study will provide participants with AI-generated responses supported by references to established medical publications. It will also examine whether sharing personal health records can improve the relevance of these answers. The initiative includes optional HealthKit data sharing and safeguards for certain health-related queries. Participation is limited to eligible users in the US.
title: Apple's New Health AI Study Lets iPhone Users Ask Medical Questions and Share HealthKit Data

description: Jio plans to stop offering free incoming calls service to users with expired recharge plans, according to a tipster. The leaker has shared a screenshot of an SMS received from “JB-JIOURG-S”. The text message informs the user that their last recharge plan expired, while also alerting them that incoming calls on the SIM “may stop anytime soon”. The message, seemingly sent from Jio’s automated alert system, also asks the user to renew their prepaid plan to “stay connected”, suggesting the incoming calls service could be blocked for users if their recharge plan stays deactivated for a long time.
title: Jio to Reportedly Start Blocking Incoming Calls for Subscribers Who Do Not Recharge Their SIM

description: Samsung is reportedly working on Galaxy Claw, which could allow Galaxy AI to interact with applications and services installed on a device. An APK teardown of the company's Personal Agent Core app has revealed references to the upcoming feature. It could offer scheduled task automation. The feature is expected to include features like Daily Brief, Device Cleaner and Travel Planner.
title: Samsung Galaxy Claw AI Feature Could Automate Tasks Across Apps, APK Teardown Suggests

description: Google announced a new HiLight hardware feature with the launch of its Pixel 11 Pro series. The feature which works like a traditional LED notification light has not been received very well because of limited support. A recent Pixel Drop seems to have added WhatsApp messages notification support for HiLight.
title: Pixel Drop Secretly Adds WhatsApp Message Notification HiLight Support to PIxel 11 Pro Series

description: Xiaomi has revised the prices of 19 Redmi smartphone variants in India, with the changes taking effect on November 16. According to a recent report, the increases range from Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 4,000, with the average hike standing at 10.02 percent. The Redmi A7 Pro 5G has received the steepest percentage increase, while select Redmi Note 17 5G and Redmi Note 17 Pro 5G variants have also become more expensive. Existing retail stocks may still be available at earlier prices.
title: Xiaomi Reportedly Raises Redmi Smartphone Prices in India by Up to Rs 4,000

description: Luxor Mining Services will compensate customers affected by an attack that redirected their computing resources through its Commander software. Around a dozen accounts were affected, and engineers fixed the issue within two hours. CEO Nick Hansen also pointed to an AI-enabled attack vector, although its use in this incident remains unconfirmed.
title: Bitcoin Mining Rewards Stolen After Hackers Hijack Mining Operations

description: Oppo Pad Air 6 has been launched in China as the latest addition to the company's tablet lineup. It is offered in Encounter Blue and Starlight Silver (translated from Chinese) colour options. The tablet sports a 12.1-inch 2.8K (2,800 × 1,980 pixels) LCD touchscreen, offering up to a 120Hz refresh rate, 7:5 aspect ratio, 88.5 percent screen-to-body ratio, 6.7mm thick bezels, 284 ppi pixel density, 540Hz touch sampling rate, up to 900 nits peak brightness, 100 percent sRGB colour gamut, and 98 percent DCI-P3 colour gamut. It is also offered in a Soft Light display version. Powering the Oppo Pad Air 6 is an octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 7360 Super chipset, delivering a peak clock speed of up to 2.5GHz. The tablet also features an Arm Mali-G615 MC2 GPU, up to 12GB of LPDDR5x RAM, and up to 256GB of UFS 3.1 onboard storage.
title: Oppo Pad Air 6 Launched With 12.1-Inch Display and 10,050mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: The Oppo Reno 17 series was launched in China on Monday. The latest lineup comprises two models — Oppo Reno 17 and Reno 17 Pro. Both models feature dedicated chips for touch response and network connectivity, along with support for 120fps gaming. The vanilla model is powered by the Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset, while the Reno 17 Pro gets MediaTek’s Dimensity 8550 Super under the hood. The Oppo Reno 17 series ships with ColorOS 17, based on Android 17.
title: Oppo Reno 17 Pro With Dimensity 8550 Super Chip Launched Alongside Reno 17: Price, Specifications

description: Lenovo Googlebook Duet 13 will be launched in select global markets in January 2027, according to a tipster. Further, the Lenovo Googlebook Duet 13 is shown to feature a flat rear panel, with a single rear camera system placed in the top-left corner. Under the camera sensor, the laptop is shown to sport the Glowbar, a multi-colour light bar found on all Googlebook models. On other Googlebook series devices, the Glowbar lights up when a user is using Gemini. The Lenovo Googlebook Duet 13 might also ship with the Googlebook OS, the same as other models. The rumoured Lenovo Googlebook Duet 13 appears with a white folio case, with an integrated keyboard. The keyboard could be held in place with magnets and might allow users to detach it, depending on their usage. The Lenovo Googlebook Duet 13 is expected to ship with stylus support.
title: Lenovo Googlebook Duet 13 Will Launch Early Next Year With a Detachable Touchscreen and Stylus Support, Tipster Claims

description: Airtel announced that Airtel Insider offers rewards worth over Rs. 30,000. The benefits span several categories, including shopping, entertainment, learning, and health and wellness. The company has associated with brands like Duolingo, Croma and Pocket FM.  Eligible Airtel Mobile and Home customers can access the offers through the Airtel app.
title: Airtel Announces Insider Offers Worth Over Rs. 30,000 Across Duolingo, Croma, Cinepolis, More

description: Grand Theft Auto pre-orders have reportedly generated over $1 billion in revenue. According to a market research firm, the game has sold over 12 million copies across PS5 and Xbox Series S/X before launch. PS5 sales reportedly account for 75 percent of the pre-orders. GTA 6 is set to launch on November 19.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Has Reportedly Generated Over $1 Billion From Pre-Orders Before Launch

description: South Korean cryptocurrency exchange Coinone has disclosed a customer data leak involving servers managed by its outsourced service provider, MetaM. The compromised information may include personal identification details, passwords, bank account numbers, and cryptocurrency wallet addresses. Coinone said its trading and wallet infrastructure remained separate from the affected systems and that it had found no evidence of a direct intrusion into those platforms.
title: Coinone Warns of Potential Exposure of Passwords, IDs, and Crypto Wallet Addresses

description: Samsung Galaxy A18 4G was launched in Singapore, following its debut in Europe in September. The new model features MediaTek's Helio G99+ SoC. The European version runs on the Samsung Exynos 1610 chipset. Apart from the processor, both variants share similar specifications. The Galaxy A18 4G has a 6.7-inch Super AMOLED display with a 90Hz refresh rate, a 5,000mAh battery and a triple rear camera unit. The smartphone also offers an IP64 rating and a side-mounted fingerprint sensor. It runs on Android 17-based One UI 9.
title: Samsung Galaxy A18 4G Launched With MediaTek Helio G99+ SoC, 5,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Lava Probuds Xplore 13 were launched in India on Monday. The latest true wireless stereo (TWS) earphones from the homegrown brand come with 13mm drivers. They offer Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity and Intelligent Noise Cancellation (INC). Lava says the TWS earbuds have an IPX5 rating for water resistance. The Lava Probuds Xplore 13 are claimed to offer up to 30 hours of total playback on a single charge, with the charging case.
title: Lava Probuds Xplore 13 Launched in India With 13mm Drivers, 30 Hours Battery Life: Price, Specifications

description: Bitcoin recovered towards $65,000 on Monday after falling close to $62,000 over the weekend. However, the broader market remains under pressure as US spot Bitcoin ETFs continue to record withdrawals and mid-sized holders reduce their exposure. Analysts have also highlighted contracting liquidity, bearish technical indicators, and leveraged positions as factors that could influence Bitcoin’s next move.
title: Bitcoin Trades Near $64,700 as Weak Demand and Institutional Selling Weigh on Crypto Market

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra will be launched next year with a redesigned rear camera module, according to a tipster. The rumoured Galaxy S27 Pro is said to feature the same horizontal camera island. On top of this, the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra and Galaxy S27 Pro are shown to feature a triple rear camera system. If this is true, it would be a downgrade from the quad camera unit on the Galaxy S26 Ultra, which is led by a 200-megapixel primary shooter. However, the next-generation Ultra model will continue to sport four cutouts, where the fourth cutout might house the LED flash. A secondary microphone could be placed between the third sensor and the LED flash.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra and Galaxy S27 Pro Reportedly Confirmed to Feature a Redesigned Rear Camera Module

description: Jensen Huang is considering a comeback as Nvidia's chief executive, and has discussed with confidants the possibility of returning, the Financial Times reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with the matter. Huang stepped down on Thursday after revelations of extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy that raised questions over exports of the company's advanced AI chips to China.
title: Jensen Huang Discusses Comeback as Nvidia CEO With Allies: Report

description: Xiaomi is preparing to introduce its Clip open-ear wireless earbuds to global markets on November 17. The product listing details its audio hardware, connectivity options and battery specifications, including 11mm dynamic drivers, LHDC 5.0 support and up to 38 hours of playback with the charging case. The earbuds also come with an IP57 rating, four microphones and Apple Find My support. They will be unveiled alongside several other Xiaomi products, including the Xiaomi 18 Pro series and Smart Band 11.
title: Xiaomi Clip Earbuds Listed Globally With 38-Hour Battery Life, Apple Find My Support Ahead of Launch

description: WhatsApp is said to be testing further refinements of Apple’s Liquid Glass design language for the messaging app on iPhone. According to a feature tracker, the latest beta update of WhatsApp for iOS focuses on two key areas that have yet to receive the refreshed interface. The messaging app is reportedly enhancing Liquid Glass elements in the chat info screen and the drawing editor, introducing glass-like elements to the action buttons and editing toolbar.
title: WhatsApp Reportedly Rolling Out Liquid Glass Design Updates to Chat Info Screen, Drawing Editor on iPhone

description: A new report sheds plenty of light on how Apple has worked on and plans to introduce its smart glasses to its future customers. From the grand idea behind using an agentic Siri to what powers the experience and the hardware that it all runs on. Apple’s smart glasses will compete with Meta’s Ray-Ban glasses and Google’s recently announced Android XR-powered devices which were designed in collaboration with Samsung.
title: Apple Glasses to Use Siri AI to Power Its Smart Glasses Experience: Report

description: Motorola Edge 70 Neo will be launched in India soon, the company has confirmed. The handset will be available for purchase via Flipkart. In terms of design, the Motorola Edge 70 Neo is shown to debut with a familiar design. It will sport a curved rear panel with rounded corners. The phone will also boast a similar square-shaped rear camera module, featuring three camera cutouts. Upon a closer look, the marketing material reveals that the Edge 70 Neo will boast a dual rear camera setup, headlined by a 50-megapixel primary shooter with a Sony LYTIA sensor, optical image stabilisation, and Ultra HDR support.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Neo India Launch Teased Along With Design as Microsite Goes Live

description: The Vivo Pad FE has recently been the subject of rumours lately, which suggests its launch could be on the horizon. The unannounced model is said to be making progress through regulatory approvals. Now, a tipster claims that it has been sighted on yet another certification platform, further strengthening rumours about its debut in global markets. While the latest listing does not reveal its specifications, earlier certifications have offered a few clues about its connectivity and charging capabilities.
title: Vivo Pad FE Reportedly Spotted on Taiwan's NCC Certification Database, Global Launch Seems Imminent

description: Apple’s 20th anniversary iPhone model’s 3D Quad-Curved Glass cover has been spotted in a leaked hands-on video. The video specifies that the glass cover belongs to the iPhone 20 Pro. It suggests that the next-generation candybar iPhone model will sport a notably redesigned front panel. The lineup might continue to feature four rounded corners, with the glass curving into the smartphone’s metal mid-frame. On top of this, the purported hands-on video also shows the rumoured iPhone 20 Pro with two black markings on the front, which could be for the front-facing camera. The handset might retain the smaller dynamic island as its predecessor. This further suggests that the Face ID sensor could be placed in the top-left corner under the display of the iPhone 20 Pro, similar to this year’s Pro and Pro Max models.
title: Apple’s 20th Anniversary iPhone to Sport a 3D Quad-Curved Glass Display, Leaked Hands-On Video Suggests

description: Apple is reportedly working on its first smart glasses, with an unveiling expected at WWDC 2027 and a release planned for later that year. According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, internal prototypes feature slimmer frames than Meta's second-generation Ray-Ban glasses, with cameras integrated into oval-shaped openings. The company is also testing a magnetic charging connector and front-facing privacy indicators. Unlike augmented reality headsets, the glasses are not expected to display digital information over the wearer's surroundings, with audio and camera features taking priority.
title: Apple Smart Glasses Could Debut at WWDC 2027 With Slim Frames, Built-In Cameras

description: Sony introduced the QSSR AI upscaler in Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei last month. The feature is now confirmed to arrive in six more PS5 games. QSSR support is live in Marvel's Spider-Man 2 and will be rolled out to Arc Raiders, The Finals, Control Resonant, Hell Let Loose: Vietnam, and No Man's Sky in the coming weeks.
title: Sony's QSSR Upscaler Is Coming to Marvel's Spider-Man 2, Control Resonant, Arc Raiders and More PS5 Games

description: HMD 2320 Flip 4G key specifications leaked online. It is said to feature a 2.4-inch primary LCD panel and a 1.77-inch external display. It could run on a Unisoc T127 processor, paired with 64MB of RAM and 128MB of internal storage. The upcoming handset could come with GPS-based real-time tracking, push-to-talk communication and a dedicated SOS function.
title: HMD 2320 Flip 4G Specifications Leaked; Tipped to Offer GPS Tracking, SOS Function

description: Samsung is said to have hiked the prices of several smartphones in its Galaxy M and Galaxy F lineups in India. According to a tipster, the alleged price revision affects select RAM and storage configurations of the Galaxy M17, Galaxy M17e and Galaxy F70e. The updated prices allegedly cover the 4GB and 6GB RAM variants of the three models, while the tipster claims that the Galaxy M17's 8GB RAM option has also become more expensive.
title: Samsung Galaxy M17, M17e, F70e Prices in India Hiked by Up to Rs. 2,000, Claims Tipster

description: Apple is reportedly preparing the second-generation iPhone Duo. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says bringing Face ID to the iPhone Duo 2 is currently one of the company's biggest priorities. Apple is also reportedly considering adding an Action button to the iPhone Duo 2. The company is considering adding a dedicated telephoto camera and making the device thinner and lighter.
title: Apple's iPhone Duo 2 to Bring Face ID, Action Button, Telephoto Camera: Mark Gurman

description: Oppo will launch the Reno 17 series in China on November 16. The series will comprise the standard Reno 17 and Reno 17 Pro models. The company has officially confirmed the RAM and storage details of the phones. Additionally, tipster Digital Chat Station has revealed the key specifications of both smartphones, including their display sizes, processors, cameras and battery capacities.
title: Oppo Reno 17, Reno 17 Pro RAM and Storage Configurations Teased; Key Specifications Leaked
